items.summary: In this proposed rule, the Department of Labor (Department) clarifies the fiduciary duty of loyalty under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA). The proposed rule affirms that ERISA's duty of loyalty requires fiduciaries to act with the exclusive purpose of ensuring retirement security and providing promised benefits to plan participants and their beneficiaries. The amendments clarify the neutral application of ERISA's fiduciary duties of prudence and loyalty to selecting investments and investment courses of action, and to exercising shareholder rights, including proxy voting, the use of written proxy voting policies and guidelines, and shareholder engagement…
items.title: Loyalty and the Exclusive Purpose Rule in Selecting Plan Investments and Exercising Shareholder Rights

items.summary: The Commission will consider a Report and Order that would adopt a limited two- year extension of Alternative Connect America Cost Model (A-CAM I) support through December 31, 2028. A-CAM I currently provides predictable, model- based support to rural rate-of-return carriers in exchange for defined broadband deployment obligations, and this extension would prevent a loss of support for nine carriers while the Commission considers broader reforms to its high-cost support mechanisms. ------------------------------------------------------------------------

items.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (Commission) is revising its regulations addressing the circumstances under which a request for rehearing is denied absent Commission action within a particular time frame. Currently, the Commission's regulations provide that unless the Commission acts upon a request for rehearing within 30 days after the request is filed, the request is denied. As revised in this final rule, the regulation will apply only to matters subject to the rehearing and judicial review provisions in the Federal Power Act (FPA) and Natural Gas Act (NGA).
